reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Colorado
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Whether "personal service to suitable person other than defendant" is a permitted
              *secondary* method of service for an eviction action.

    Statute encoded: CO Code  13-40-112 (2021)
*/

% --------------------------
% Scenario (facts)
% --------------------------

scenario_state(colorado).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_action_type(eviction_action).

% The method we are asked about:
scenario_service_method(personal_service_to_suitable_person_other_than_defendant).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is in place.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(colorado),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action_type(eviction_action),
    scenario_service_method(personal_service_to_suitable_person_other_than_defendant).

% --------------------------
% Statute translation (deterministic)
% --------------------------

/*
  CO Code  13-40-112 (2021):
  - Summons may be served by personal service as in any civil action (primary).
  - If personal service cannot be had upon the defendant after diligent effort,
    service may be made by posting summons+complaint conspicuously on the premises.
  - In addition, plaintiff shall mail (next business day) a copy of summons (or alias)
    and complaint to defendant at the premises by first-class mail.

  For the purposes of this question, "secondary methods of service" are those available
  only if the primary method is unsuccessful.
*/

% Primary method(s) explicitly recognized by the statute text.
% We keep this abstract: "personal service as in any civil action".
statute_co_13_40_112_primary_service_method(colorado, 2021, eviction_action, personal_service_as_in_any_civil_action) :- !.

% Secondary method explicitly authorized when personal service cannot be had after diligent effort:
% posting summons+complaint AND additionally mailing copies.
statute_co_13_40_112_secondary_service_method(colorado, 2021, eviction_action, posting_and_mailing) :- !.

% --------------------------
% Method normalization / classification
% --------------------------

% Normalize various described methods into the abstract buckets we reason over.

% The asked-about method is a kind of "personal service" (substituted personal service),
% which (if allowed at all) would fall under the statute's primary bucket "personal service as in any civil action",
% not under the statute's secondary posting+mail bucket.
normalize_method(personal_service_to_suitable_person_other_than_defendant, personal_service_as_in_any_civil_action) :- !.
normalize_method(posting_and_mailing, posting_and_mailing) :- !.
normalize_method(personal_service_as_in_any_civil_action, personal_service_as_in_any_civil_action) :- !.

% --------------------------
% Legal reasoning
% --------------------------

% Is a given described method a permitted *secondary* method under CO 13-40-112?
permitted_secondary_method(State, Year, ActionType, DescribedMethod) :-
    normalize_method(DescribedMethod, Normalized),
    statute_co_13_40_112_secondary_service_method(State, Year, ActionType, Normalized),
    !.

permitted_secondary_method(_State, _Year, _ActionType, _DescribedMethod) :-
    fail.

% --------------------------
% Answer (deterministic yes/no)
% --------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action_type(ActionType),
    scenario_service_method(Method),
    permitted_secondary_method(State, Year, ActionType, Method),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% --------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% --------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is personal service to suitable person other than defendant a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
